pages.name: Neo-King's Indian: Torre Attack
pages.notes: Overview called the g5-bishop light-squared; plan 1 wrote the set-up as a route (Nbd2-e3-c3) and claimed Bxf6 damages Black's structure; plan 4 offered ...gxf6 with the pawn on g6. Rewrote overview and plans 1 and 4 (reviewer rejection fixed and re-reviewed).

pages.name: Queen's Pawn Game: Barry Attack
pages.notes: Plan 4 played ...Bd6 with Black's dark-squared bishop on g7; plan 1 aimed for a sacrifice on h7 against an uncastled king. Rewrote plans 1 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Torre Attack: Fianchetto Defense, Euwe Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 developed Be2 or Bd3 with the e-pawn on e2 and wrote castling as 0-0; plan 1 said Bxf6 damages a structure the g7-bishop protects. Rewrote plans 1 and 3 (reviewer rejection fixed and re-reviewed).

pages.name: Black Knights Tango
pages.notes: Plan 2 aimed at an e4-pawn that does not exist. Fixed plan 2; British spelling.

pages.name: Mexican Defense: Horsefly Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 wrote the push as e4-e5 with the e-pawn on e2 and Black's knight on e5. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: Budapest: Fajarowicz, 4.Nf3
pages.notes: Plan 3 fianchettoed the queen's bishop to attack a non-existent e4-pawn; plan 1 suggested ...b6/...Bb7 instead of the gambit's real ideas; plan 4 wrote 0-0 and Be2 without e3. Rewrote all four plans.

pages.name: Budapest: Fajarowicz, 4.Nf3 Bb4+
pages.notes: Plan 1 played ...Bxc3+ with no knight on c3. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: Budapest: Fajarowicz, 4.Nf3 Nc6 5.a3
pages.notes: Plan 2 read b4 as a Black move; overview called ...Bb4+ a pin. Rewrote overview and plan 2; British spelling.

pages.name: Budapest: Rubinstein, 4...Bb4+
pages.notes: Plan 4 played Bg2 without g3 while in check. Rewrote plan 4 (a first rewrite with h3 was rejected and replaced by the main line Nd2, Ngf3, e3, Be2; re-reviewed).

pages.name: Budapest: Rubinstein, Main Line
pages.notes: Overview called the f4-bishop light-squared; plan 3 pointed at a d4-pawn that does not exist. Rewrote overview and plan 3; British spelling.
